title: Evaluation of a flattened CNF list
statement: Let $X$ be a list, let each element be assigned a CNF over a fixed variable type, and let $a$ assign a Boolean value to each variable. The concatenation of the assigned CNFs evaluates to true under $a$ if and only if every CNF assigned to an element occurring in $X$ evaluates to true under $a$.
hypotheses_covered: A CNF-valued function on the elements of $X$
A Boolean assignment to the variables
